_comment: RAG golden set (lessons 7 and 9) over data/data_clean/chunks.jsonl. Format and rules: hr_compass/testset.py. Check it with: python scripts/evals.py --lint. relevant = the chunks that answer the question, as a quote (+ end of the source path), resolved at load time; must = facts the answer must contain, every group needs one option (options in Ukrainian are for answers in Ukrainian); archived copies are never relevant.

cases.question: How many days a week can I work from home?

relevant.quote: 0 – 3 years of service – one day per week

cases.reference: One day a week (Wednesday or Thursday) with 0-3 years of service, two days a week after 3 years.

cases.question: How much does the company pay toward my commute if I come to the office three days a week?

relevant.quote: Employees commuting 2–3 days per week: $75 per month

cases.reference: $75 per month for employees who come to the office 2-3 days a week.
cases.trap: The archived 2025 handbooks (hr only) still give a flat $132 a month; an answer with $132 relies on an outdated source.

cases.question: How long is the probation period for a new hire?

relevant.quote: standard adaptation (probation) period is 3 months

cases.reference: 3 months; 1 month for Affordable Housing and Property Tax Analysts.

cases.question: What should the background of my profile picture look like?

relevant.quote: solid neutral background

cases.reference: A solid neutral background, gray is preferred.

cases.question: What time does the Costa Rica team start and finish the workday?

relevant.quote: 7.00 am – 4.00 pm Costa Rica Time

cases.reference: 7:00 am to 4:00 pm Costa Rica time, with a 1-hour lunch break.

cases.question: On which days are the advanced English classes held?

relevant.quote: C1–C2 Group: Monday & Wednesday

cases.reference: The C1-C2 group meets on Monday and Wednesday, 10:00-11:00 Kyiv time.

cases.question: What rate am I paid for hours beyond 40 in a week?

relevant.quote: one and one-half times (1.5) their normal hourly wage

cases.reference: Non-exempt employees get 1.5 times their normal hourly wage for hours over 40 in a workweek.

cases.question: How many hours of paid sick time do I get each year in New York?

relevant.quote: grant of 40 hours of paid safe and sick time

cases.reference: 40 hours of paid safe and sick time, granted at the start of each calendar year.

cases.question: How often is pay reviewed for the Affordable Housing Processing Team?

relevant.quote: salary reviews are conducted every 6 months

cases.reference: Every 6 months; the hiring manager tracks the cycle and starts the review.

cases.question: How many floating holidays do employees on the EU team get?

relevant.quote: entitled to five (5) Floating Holidays

cases.reference: Five floating holidays per calendar year.

cases.question: How much vacation do US employees accrue per year during their first three years?

relevant.quote: | 0–3 years | 1.77 hours | 92 hours (11.5 days) |

cases.reference: 1.77 hours a week, 92 hours (11.5 days) a year for full-time employees.

cases.question: How many days of annual leave do employees in Ukraine have?

relevant.quote: twenty-four (24) calendar days of paid annual leave

cases.reference: 24 calendar days of paid annual leave a year.

cases.question: DB-450

relevant.quote: Short-term disability claim form (DB-450)

cases.reference: DB-450 is the short-term disability claim form: get it from HR and send it to NYSIF Disability Benefits Claims.

cases.question: form PFL-DC-120

relevant.quote: PFL-DC-120

cases.reference: PFL-DC-120 is the Paid Family Leave Discrimination Complaint filed with the Workers' Compensation Board.

cases.question: Vchasno

relevant.quote: employment contract prior to their official start date (via Vchasno)

cases.reference: New employees sign the employment contract in Vchasno before their official start date.

cases.question: Speaking Club

relevant.quote: Speaking Club: Friday

cases.reference: The English Speaking Club meets on Fridays, 10:00-11:00 Kyiv time.

cases.question: Скільки днів на тиждень можна працювати з дому?

relevant.quote: 0 – 3 years of service – one day per week

cases.reference: Один день на тиждень при стажі до 3 років, два дні після 3 років.

cases.question: Скільки днів щорічної відпустки мають працівники в Україні?

relevant.quote: twenty-four (24) calendar days of paid annual leave

cases.reference: 24 календарні дні оплачуваної щорічної відпустки.

cases.question: Який фон має бути на фото профілю?

relevant.quote: solid neutral background

cases.reference: Однотонний нейтральний фон, бажано сірий.

cases.question: Скільки триває випробувальний термін для нового працівника?

relevant.quote: standard adaptation (probation) period is 3 months

cases.reference: 3 місяці; для Affordable Housing і Property Tax Analysts — 1 місяць.

cases.question: With how many days' notice can either party terminate a contractor agreement?

relevant.quote: terminate this Agreement for any reason upon 7 (seven) days' prior written notice

cases.reference: Either party may terminate for any reason with 7 days' prior written notice.

cases.question: Do we offer company benefits to interns?

relevant.quote: As a temporary intern, you will not be eligible for Company benefits.

cases.reference: No. A temporary intern is not eligible for Company benefits; interns are paid hourly, weekly, and are eligible for overtime.

cases.question: I joined three months ago. Can I already work from home?

relevant.quote: 0 – 3 years of service – one day per week

cases.reference: Yes. New employees may work remotely after 60 days of employment, and with 0-3 years of service that is one day a week (Wednesday or Thursday).
cases.trap: The archived handbooks (hr only) list weekly remote days from 1-3 years of service, so an answer built on them says 'not before 1 year'; they also say 60 days, so they contradict themselves.

cases.question: Does the company reimburse a gym membership?
cases.reference: The documents do not say: the bot must say it has no information.

cases.question: Do I get a 13th-month salary?
cases.reference: The documents do not say: the bot must say it has no information.

cases.question: Чи можна приводити собаку в офіс?
cases.reference: Документи цього не описують: бот має сказати, що не має такої інформації.
